summary: NOVAGOLD Resources filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 disclosing it filed and commenced mailing its management information circular and definitive Schedule 14A proxy statement (US equivalent of a Canadian circular) for a November 3, 2026 special meeting to approve acquiring the 40% Donlin Gold LLC stake held by Paulson Advisers affiliates in an all-share transaction, lifting NOVAGOLD's interest from 60% to 100% through newly incorporated New NOVAGOLD. Post-close, current NOVAGOLD holders own roughly 65%, Paulson about 39.7% economic with voting capped at 19.99%. The board unanimously recommends approval. Watch shareholder-vote outcome and any dissenting minority or regulatory delay risk.
